result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on the two prior open findings, the quick-fix artifact, and directly touched test surfaces. priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved by `tests/context-steward/long-thread-real-pi-execution.e2e.test.ts:824-898`, which now runs PI again from `compactResult.generatedFilePath`, verifies appended session rows include the post-compact marker and continuation directory, waits for the post-smart-compact turn to close and smooth, and asserts three closed appended turns remain in canonical source state. `npm run verify-all` passed with this E2E included.

Resolved by `tests/thread/async-thread-run-service.test.ts:1011-1098`, which removes selected `lowerBand.brief`, verifies a brief-band provider call, asserts the visible `(brief)` catch-up warning, and confirms ready brief output is persisted; and by `tests/thread/async-thread-run-service.test.ts:1210-1264`, which proves brief catch-up failure blocks with a chunk-and-brief-specific error.

productionPathFindings: No material Story 5 runtime production-path workaround was introduced by the quick-fix; the directly touched changes are test coverage only. Existing placeholder-era inspection/reporting behavior remains outside the Story 5 runtime readiness scope and is covered by later story work.
additionalObservations: `npm run verify` passed locally with 488 service tests, 0 failures.
`npm run verify-all` passed locally: it reran the 488 service tests, the standard E2E suite, and the long-thread PI E2E including the smart-compact generated-rollout continuation test.
